covered.rule: 1 Start exactly: "Good day, this is Larkspur Business Bank's automated assistant. We record this call."
1 Ask exactly "Am I speaking with {{title}} {{last_name}}?"
1 Ask at most twice; unclear -> lark_unreached / lark_unclear
1 never say arrears, overdue, facility, payment before verification
1 Address as title and last name; yes/speaking/own name confirms; hello or a question does not
2 Callbacks next business day 08:30-16:15 inclusive, strictly after now
2 Invalid slot ask once; second failure -> lark_unreached / lark_no_callback; success -> lark_callback
2 Third parties: disclose nothing; missing hour must be clarified
2 Wrong number -> lark_unreached / lark_wrong_number
2 Deceased: "Please accept our condolences." -> lark_unreached / lark_deceased
3 Four questions in order postcode, birth_year, company_number, founded_year
3 Answer formats text/year/digits(8)/year
3 Max 4 wrong answers, use API checks_left
3 Exhaustion: "Please contact our business desk." -> lark_unverified / lark_failed
3 Explain once after refusal; second refusal -> lark_unverified / lark_declined
3 Question about why security is needed is not a refusal
3 No recoverable-format hint
4 Up to 2 products
4 Product naming
4 State all products before asking anything
4 "Next Friday" = following calendar week
4 Missing month/year -> next occurrence on or after today
5 Days late 1-45: end_of_month basis=business adjustment=preceding
5 One attempt: full on deadline, floor if full already refused
5 "Can you settle all these products today?" / "Can you settle this today?"
5 Separate attempt counters in get_account order; exhaustion -> lark_refused
5 Common date clamped to each product's deadline
6 Floors by kind
6 Full first, floor once, "The remainder stays overdue.", never ask how much, accept floor..full
6 Date may be today, business day, roll forward within deadline else deadline, vague ask once
6 Never offer discount, waiver or new instalment plan
covered.where: no IR field (prompt-level); restructuring request -> special_cases[restructuring]

covered.rule: 7 "May I record these promises?", one batch read-back, correction needs new read-back
7 One create_promise per product; retry once; second failure -> lark_service_error
7 "We will email confirmation to your registered address."
7 "Please contact our business desk to change a recorded promise."
8 Already paid
8 Dispute
8 Hardship: offer lark_care, accepted -> lark_transferred / lark_care, else lark_distress
8 Restructure -> lark_restructure, lark_transferred / lark_restructure
8 Human: ask once, insist -> lark_desk, lark_transferred / lark_person
8 Refusal to talk: ask once, second refusal ends call, remaining products lark_refused
8 Robot reply
8 Scam reply and continue
8 Cannot-answer sentence
9 One note per unpromised product, allowed reasons; none on transfer
9 Transfer cancels unrecorded proposals, keeps recorded promises
9 Outcome precedence
9 Goodbye before single close_call
9 Debt introduction "I am calling about the overdue business products."
10 Outcome code table
Header: no other policy or amendment applies
